title: My big, fat, technophobic cat
summary: Before moving, Pablo and Petey shared spaces and litter boxes begrudgingly. Pablo 7, Tech 1 (I count the smart glasses as a win) After eight years of technological warfare, however, there are two gadgets that Pablo tolerates — likes, even.
